items.q: That was Fifi, Mary's dog, I think Fifi wanted to get into the act, too.

ctx.x: All right, we're back now after a short interruption, we've been sorting out a case of petty larceny at the House that Jazz Built.
Yeah, things are beginning to show up one at a time. That was Fifi, Mary's dog, I think Fifi wanted to get into the act, too.
Do you just want to say a sentence or two about the case of -- just to give a sense of the kind things you have to put up with running a project like this in South Bronx.
